text: Upon the destruction of the impressions generated by merit and demerit, and upon the separation of the body (death), since the purpose of existence has been fulfilled, the withdrawal of Pradhana leads to the attainment of a specialized liberation (Viśiṣṭa-kaivalya) that is absolute, inevitable, final, and permanent, encompassing both the state of isolation (Kaivalya) and the state of pure liberation (Moksha).
